phase: 9B.1 — real accounts, cloud career, My EraClash

results.name: the account identity comes from verifying the token with the provider, never from a body
the game data comes from the authoritative record, never from the request
ownership is proved by the server-minted device session cookie
one result has one owner, decided by a primary key rather than a check-then-write race
a repeated save is idempotent on (user, result)
a save never re-runs the simulation
the snapshot drops the device session, so a career row cannot identify a browser
a challenge is fingerprinted, never stored in the clear
a proposed import list is capped and every id is authorised on its own
only authoritative result-id shapes are accepted
the career row's scores, era, MVP and candidate all come from the record
a tie and a loss are derived from the score, not from a `won` claim
no device session appears anywhere in the stored row
the current result is claimed once
a repeated claim creates no duplicate
a second account cannot claim the same result
another device's result is refused
an unknown result id is refused honestly
an unverifiable token saves nothing
a device import takes only this device's results
a repeated import is safe and adds nothing
the visible save states are the three the specification names
a failed save keeps the result and offers a retry
